name: Live
description: Enables this Agent's paired LIVE and Heartbeat presence.

name: Heartbeat Skills
description: What this Agent's Heartbeat does beyond being present, such as starting initiatives. Every tick carries them in full, so each must stay under 1,500 characters and point at a full Skill for anything more. Needs Live.

name: Optional Skills
description: Skills this Agent may attach to one discussion itself, when the conversation needs them, without asking. They are not on every discussion like its Skills. You can attach any Skill to a discussion from its header; the Agent asks you first for one that is not listed here.

name: Heartbeat Automation
description: System-maintained canonical automation for this Agent's paired LIVE and Heartbeat presence.
